card.name: Punctuation in credits and address lines
card.fires_on: Commas, parentheses and small linking words right after a place name, institution or legal notice in author credits, investigator lists, copyright lines and NDC package lines.

modes.label: Comma after place or institution
modes.description: A comma following a city, country or center name in an author or investigator affiliation.
modes.example: Atlanta Center for Dermatologic Disease, Atlanta<<,>> GA. Review provided by VeriMed

modes.label: Start of copyright or NDC detail
modes.description: A word or bracket right after a copyright holder or NDC code that starts the next clause.
modes.example: © 1997- 2010 A.D.A.M., Inc.<< Any>> duplication or distribution of the information contained herein

modes.label: Link after institution name
modes.description: A small word after a hospital or center name that leads into its city.
modes.example: Emergency Medicine at Newark Beth Israel Medical Center<< in>> Newark, New Jersey.

card.plain: It fires on the punctuation or small word that follows a place or organization name in credits, copyright and package lines.
